You can perform swimming movement (page 238) without taking any penalty to your Movement.

Upon acquisition of this skill, choose one debuff and effectiveness level if it needs one. Write it down as Apply Debuff: Poison(2) or the like. Treat it separately from other Apply Debuff skills. If you deal at least 1 point of damage with one of your attacks during your current Main Process, apply the chosen debuff to the target. Place the effectiveness level in parentheses "( )".

Upon acquisition of this skill, choose either close-combat (close-combat attacks), ranged (ranged attacks), magic (magic attacks) or special (special attacks). Write this skill down as Area Promotion: Close-Combat or the like. Treat it separately from other Area Promotion skills. Change the target of all attacks of the chosen type you perform to Area (SLx2 targets). This effect lasts until the end of your Main Process.

Upon acquisition of this skill, choose one element. Write this skill down as Attack Magic: Fire or the like. Treat it separately from other Attack Magic skills. Perform a magic attack against the target. The attack deals 2d6+10 magic damage of the chosen element.
Critical: Add dice

Upon acquisition of this skill, choose one element. Write this skill down as Breath: Fire or the like. Treat it separately from other Breath skills. Perform a special attack against the target or targets. Use Dexterity for your hit check. The attack deal 2d6+(ELx2) magic damage of the chosen element. Critical: Add dice

Upon acquisition of this skill, choose either close-combat (close-combat attacks), ranged (ranged attacks), magic (magic attacks) or special (special attacks). Write this skill down as Concentration: Close-Combat or the like. Treat it separately from other Concentration skills. Add (SL)d6 to the damage of attacks you perform that are the specified type. This effect lasts until the end of your Main Process.
You can use this skill only when every character in the Scene is spent. You become ready. This may only be used once per round.

Perform a close-combat attack against the target. If it hits, instead of making a damage roll, lower the target's HP by any amount less than or equal to ELx2, then restore HP. Restore an amount of your own HP equal to half of that the target lost, rounding down.

You are considered to be in a flying state. When you enter a Scene, you must choose whether or not this skill's effect should be applied. You can apply or disengage this skill's effects by using a minor action.

Upon acquisition of this skill, choose one debuff. Write this skill down as Resistance: Poison or the like. Treat it separately from other Resistance skills. The chosen debuff cannot be applied to you. You can learn this skill up to three times.

Upon acquisition of this skill, choose one weapon type. Write this skill down as Special Physical Resistance: One-Handed Sword or the like. Treat it separately from other Special Physical Resistance skills. When you would be dealt damage from a weapon attack that uses the chosen weapon type, add SLx4 to your Physical Defense.

Upon acquisition of this skill, chose one enemy type or one enemy. Write this skill down as Summon: Plant, Summon: Zombie or the like. Treat it separately from other Summons skills. Call forth one chosen enemy or one enemy of the chosen type, that is below your EL (CL). It appears in your Engagement in a spent state. This enemy cannot use any Summon skills the round it appears. You can use this skill SL times per Scene.

Upon acquisition of this skill, choose either your entire loot table or a single piece of loot from your loot table. If you chose the entire table, write this skill down as Theft Hazard. If you only chose one piece of loot, write if down as Theft Hazard: Power Unit or the like and treat it separately from other Theft Hazard skills. If you are the target of Steal (Page 156) and the loot roll targets any chosen loot item, your HP becomes 0.

Upon acquisition of this skill, choose one element or weapon type. Write this skill down as Weakness: Fire, Weakness: Blunt, or the like. Treat it separately from other Weakness skills. When this enemy receives damage from an attack using the chosen weapon type or the chosen element, treat it as an elemental weakness (page 231).
When in an Engagement with other enemies with Group Tactics, add 1 to you total check score on attacks you perform and add 2 to the damage they deal.
A skill that represents enemies working as a group.
Substract SLx2 from final check score on any dodge checks that characters Engaged with you perform. This effect only works on characters who don't also possess Stench of Death.
A skill that makes it harder for others to focus on your attacks due to your awful smell.
Use when knocked out. Recover from being knocked out and set your HP to 2d6. Once per scenario
Add SLx5 to the damage of your next weapon attack. This effect lasts until the end of your Main Process.
Remove one debuff applied to you. You take 10 points of HP Loss.

If you deal at least 1 HP in damage with a close-combat attack, neither you not the target of that attack may move or perform dodge checks. This effect lasts until the end of the Scene or until the target of that attack passes a Strength check, DL 10+(SL), during the Setup Process.
Deal SLx5 points of HP Loss to any character currently under the effects of your Swallow skill.
All globlins in the same Scene as you add 4 to the total check score of all the checks they make, and they add 1d6 to all damage they deal with attacks.
Hit checks for the attacks you perform gain a bonus equal to the number of goblins currently in the Scene. Add twice that number to any damage your attacks would deal.
Add (SL)d6 to the damage of your Breath special attacks. This effect lasts until the end of your Main Process.
Blocs the Engagements you're in. You may remove the effects of this skill at any time.

(Leg Sweep is from Advanced Rules book, same effect essentially)
A skill that hinders the opponent’s movements by intimidating them, entangling their legs with tentacles, shaking the ground, etc.
If one of your attacks reduces the target's HP to 0 or less, add SL+1 to the difficulty level of the target's death check.
All weapon attacks you perform deal piercing damage.
When you receive ice magic damage, reduce it to 0. Then change your loot table to read "Shining Blue Scale (5000 KE) instead of "Blue Scale (1500 KE)".
You appear on round 1d6+2 during the Cleanup Process in a spent state. You can only use this skill when you are not already in the Scene and there is an enemy of level 3 or less in the Scene.
Add 1d6 to your hit checks for attacks targeting characters with a CL of (your EL-1) or less.

Upon acquiring, choose one debuff. Treat each instance as a separate skill. Write this skill as “Bad Breath: (chosen debuff) (lvl)” with lvl being the debuffs strength. Perform a special attack on the targets. Damage is 2d6 + EL piercing damage. If even 1 point of HP damage is dealt, the target will be given the chosen debuff.
The skill to breath out noxious gas.

You can still choose stealthed characters as the target of your attack or skill. Additionally, no check is required to discover a stealthed character. Spending a major action you can remove stealth from any character in the scene.
A skill that uses insight and the life sensing ability of undead to detect stealthed characters.
Use after the check for a major action. Change the result of that roll to a critical. If a critical result would add extra dice, always add +2d6 to that roll, no more no less.
A skill that hinders the opponent’s movements by intimidating them, entangling their legs with tentacles, shaking the ground, etc.
The user takes the damage from the roll instead of the target. You can use this skill even if spent and if you use it while ready it will not make you spent.
A skill that represents the ability to shield and protect others.

Upon acquiring this skill, choose one enemy appearance other than yourself. Write this skill as “Transformation: (chosen appearance)”. Treat instances of the skill as separate. You can declare it at any time to transform into the selected appearance or undo the transformation. In order to detect the transformation you must make an Identify Enemy Check with difficulty equal to the ID Score of the actual monster. If failed, the PC’s receive information on the disguised monster not the real monster.
Active when you are not under a negative effect. Add (SL)d6 to the damage of your attacks.
A skill that represents the destructive power of an attack when in perfect condition.
Recover HP equal to SL x 3.

Do not confuse with "Regenerate"
A skill that allows the user to quickly heal injuries by accelerating metabolism and using magic bestowed on the body.

When you take magic damage from an element that you are weak to, the weakness is ignored, and your magic defense is applied as normal to calculate the damage. This effect is negated if you have a debuff.
A skill that indicates that weak points are being protected by special armor or scales.

When you take magic damage from an element that you are weak to, the weakness is ignored, and your magic defense is applied as normal to calculate the damage. If an identify enemy check against you is successful, this effect will be nullified until the end of the scenario.
A skill that indicates a weak point has been nullified by a special internal structure, magic formula, etc.
Add SL to the success of checks made by the targets. This skill cannot target you. This effect lasts until the end of the round.
A skill that multiplies the abilities of subordinates by giving precise instructions.
The engagement you are in becomes blocked. This blockade also has an effect on flying characters. Players can tell this skill has been acquired without doing an identify enemy check.
A skill that displays a towering size.
Effective when your HP is more than half. Your HP cannot be reduced to 0 by “Theft Hazard” (Basic Rulebook pg. 275).
A skill that shows that it is possible to continue functioning even if a body part has been stolen by using spare organs or strong screws to fasten it.
Effective when you have a debuff. Increases attack damage by SL x 4.
This is an enemy skill that indicates the more the enemy becomes setback, the more violent they become.

Reduce damage you take by SL x 10 (minimum 0). Also, ignore any penalties on checks due to debuffs. If a character appearing in the scene wins an opposing mind check against you, this effect is nullified until the end of the scene. The GM may change the ability score used in the check.
A skill that allows one to withstand any attack by having a strong heart or willingness to sacrifice one’s life.
The target must make a strength reaction check. If you win, move the target to the engagement you are in.
A skill that draws the targeted opponent close using tongue or vines.

When you use a skill with usage: n times per scene / scenario, the number of uses is not consumed. If an identity enemy check against you is successful, this effect is disabled until the end of the scenario.
A skill that allows the infinite use of a skill through special rituals or devices.

When acquiring this skill, choose one attack method. Write this skill as “Blow Away: (chosen method)”. Treat each instance as a separate skill. If the selected attack you perform deals at leat 1 HP of damage, the target of that attack will move to a location within SL x 5m. This movement can also cause the target to leave the engagement and is not affected by blockade. You decide the direction moved. This effect lasts until the end of the main process.
Perform two weapon attacks. This attack cannot be skill of timing: major action. You can attack the same target twice or different targets.
A skill that performs consecutive weapon attacks.
Gain +1 damage to your attacks for every enemy with the same name as you in your engagement.
A skill that represents a swarm of enemies attacking.
If you land a critical hit, the damage of that attack is changed to piercing damage.
A skill that uses the thorns on your body or armor to puncture your opponents armor.
Any character who sees you must perform an identify enemy check. If they fail, you may perform a sneak attack.
A skill that uses your camouflage abilities to make a surprise attack just before being noticed.
When the target is attacked, the attacker gains +1d6 to their hit checks. This effect lasts until the end of the scenario.
A skill where the user marks their target making them easier to hit.
The target must make a difficulty level 10 Mind Check. They they fail, they suffer Knockback(SL).
A skill that lures in the target with false affection, opening up their defenses.
The targets must make a difficulty level 13 Mind check. If they fail, they become Stunned.
A skill that momentarily stuns those around you with a charming smile.
If you have moved 10m or more this round. Your attacks gain +2d6 damage.
A skill that shows your increased strength as you compete against others in a race.
Only effective when in an engagement with other enemies that have “Wolf Pack”. If an attack deals at least 1 HP of damage, it will inflict off-balance.
A skill that represents how wolves work best in a group.
Gain +3d6 to close-combat attacks you make against the character with the highest physical defense in the scene.
A skill that represents your determination as you run head first into the toughest thing nearby.
Sets all physical and magic damage dealt to you below SL x 10, to 0.
A skill that represents your ability to absorb and ignore low levels of damage.
Targets within 20m must make a difficulty level 16 mind check. If they fail, they become Dazed.
A skill that stuns those around you with your song.
A skill that represents your inability to move.
Mobs only. Every target exits the scene. Characters that don’t want to leave must win an opposing agility check against you. If the target wins cancel the effect of this skill on them.
A skill that compels those around you to leave you behind on the battlefield.
Whenever you deal at least 1 HP of damage with a close-combat attack, you inflict poison (4) on the target(s). This effect lasts until the end of the main process.
A skill that represents your ability to mix strikes with your poisonous tail into your attacks.

When you acquire this skill choose one element. Write this skill down as “Converging Breath: (chosen element)”. Treat it separately from other “Converging Breath” skills. Perform a special attack on the target with a hit check of 5d6+dexterity+6 and damage of 6d6+(Intelligence*12).
A skill that sprays an unrelenting torrent of elemental magic at the target.
he target must make a difficulty level 20 mind check. If they fail, they become dazed. If the target fumbles or is an NPC/Mob, they will follow you until the end of the scenario.
A skill to entrance others with your eyes.
When in an engagement that has the darkness status (Basic Rulebook pg. 238), add +(SL)d6 to any checks you make.
A skill that represents your affinity for the dark.
Only effective when the scene is in a dungeon or cave. Targets must make a difficulty level 17 perception check. On failure, they suffer off-balance.
A skill that represents your familiarity moving through labyrinths.
Change the target of “Breath” (Basic Rulebook pg. 273) to "target: 3 single targets". This effect lasts until the end of the main process.

The translation talk about "Area(3 target)", I think it's supposed to be 3 distinct target, like double shot of the archer that is 2 distinct targets, like, from differents engagements. Either that or that target 3 distinct Area. In this case that like, really strong.
Sets the trap “Weather: Thunderclouds”. This effect lasts until the scenario ends or you are incapacitated.
The skill to create a thunderous cloud over an area.
Only effective when your HP is less than half. Deal (SL)d6 lightning magic damage to each non-lightning character engaged with you.
A skill that represents your electrified body and its volatility when nearing critical condition.
The damage you deal with close-combat attacks becomes ice magic damage.
Whenever you deal at least 1 HP of damage with an attack, the attack’s target(s) gain “Putrid Stench 1”. The effect lasts until the end of the scenario or the GM decides it has ended.
A skill that spreads your stench to those you come into contact with.
Make an opposing mind check against the first target. If successful, the target gains “Enraged” against the second target.
A skill that sows discord by causing others to become enraged.
Whenever a character in the same scene as you gains “Enraged”, you recover 2d6 HP.
A skill that represents how the discord of others fuels your life force.
Only effective when your HP is less than half. Can be used at the same time as “Breath”. Increases the damage of “Breath” by +SL x 10.
The skill to use your anger and rage to fuel your breath attacks for greater destruction.
When you are killed, roll SL + 1 times to determine what gets dropped.
A skill that represents the massive amount of loot you hold and will drop upon death.
Can be used at the same time as “Breath”. Change the target of “Breath” from Target: Area (Choose) to Target: Scene (Choose)
A skill that represents the massive amount of loot you hold and will drop upon death.
Add +1d6 to hit checks and SL x 5 damage to attacks you make. This effect lasts until the end of the main process.
A skill that represents your ability to move through the ground as you attack for increased effect.
Add (SL)d6 to all earth magic attacks. This effect lasts until the end of your main process.
A skill that represents drawing power from a mithril pickaxe to bolster your earth magic.
Arianrhod 2E also have some Enemy Skills. These are not for players so no question to ask, use them or not use them, it's enterely your choice.
You work well in a unit with companions, your discipline and training showing itself when placed at the disposal of a competent commander.

When you gain this Skill, name an environment. (e.g. "Favoured Environment: Forest"). When you are in the chosen locale, you get +(SL)d6 to all dice rolls. The GM decides whether your current environment counts as your chosen locale. You may take multiple instances of this Skill for different locales.
You are strengthened in certain environs.
Until the end of this Main Process, whenever your Weapon Attack does at least 1 HP of damage, recover SLx5 HP.
By sapping your oppenents spirit, heal your wounds while stealing their vitality.
You may give 1d6 for any Check to a Character in the same Engagement as you.
Support an ally by working in tandem.
Effective when in Stealth state. You are unaffected and untargetable by Attacks and Skills with "Target: Area, Scene".
Blend into the environment, hiding your prescence completely and evading all notice.

When you attain this Skill, choose a Class. (e.g. "Skillmaster: Warrior") You may use any Skills from the chosen Class that are not "Timing: Passive". Treat the SL of this Skill as the SL of the Class Skills used. (You may not exceed the Maximum SL of any given Skill). You may learn multiple instances of this Skill for different Classes.
You have learned and mastered the Skills of a Class.
You may make Projectile- Attacks against targets in the same Engage.
By minimising your movements, you are able to use projectile attacks even at point blank range.
You are not affected by the effects of any Traps, and your actions do not cause them to activate.
You’re able to avoid the dangers of traps of various kinds.

This Skill is known to players even if <Identify Enemy> has not been conducted. You are not affected by the effects of <Enclosed Engage>. You may not possess both this Skill and <Super Large> at the same time.
You may impose -1d6 for any Check to a Character in the same Engagement as you.
Hinder the movements or actions of the opponent before you.
Make a Combat Movement, or Withdrawal. If you are in an Blocked Engagement, you may not Withdraw using this Skill
Read and use the intervals between your opponents’ actions to create or reduce distance in a flash.

You may use Skills without paying their [Cost]. Any additional costs within the Skill’s Effect must still be paid. If a Skill’s Effect allows you to pay a higher [Cost] in exchange for some bonus, that bonus is not activated.
Draw energy from the spiritual world, allowing you to use your abilities without significant mental strain.
Use 2 Magic Skills you know with [Timing: Major Action]. You may use the same Skill twice, or 2 different Skills. You may choose the same or different targets for both Skills.

Set a condition that will lead to your death. Unless you receive a [Finishing Blow] while the condition is fulfilled, you cannot be killed. If no condition was set, you cannot be killed during this combat. ([Finishing Blow] will only cause you to retreat)
You may only be killed by taking a specific course of action.
